protocol_harness.asserts: place while the gripper holds another entity is rejected before physics
protocol_harness.name: h_hold_state_conflict

protocol_harness.asserts: a decision missing a required argument is rejected as INVALID_DECISION
protocol_harness.name: h_missing_argument

protocol_harness.asserts: a candidate id never offered in this episode returns CANDIDATE_STALE
protocol_harness.name: h_stale_candidate

protocol_harness.asserts: a named candidate failing re-check is rejected while the object stays held
protocol_harness.name: h_infeasible_candidate

protocol_harness.asserts: held/support/at_rest unknown propagate as unknown, not as satisfied
protocol_harness.name: h_unknown_predicate

protocol_harness.asserts: finish with unsatisfied goals is refused and bounded
protocol_harness.name: h_false_finish

protocol_harness.asserts: the identical invalid action under an unchanged world terminates the episode
protocol_harness.name: h_repeated_invalid

protocol_harness.asserts: rejections beyond max_semantic_repairs terminate instead of looping
protocol_harness.name: h_semantic_repair_limit

protocol_harness.asserts: an empty model payload is a MODEL_ERROR outcome, not a crash
protocol_harness.name: h_empty_model_response

protocol_harness.asserts: a schema-invalid Decision is rejected with structured reasons
protocol_harness.name: h_schema_error

protocol_harness.asserts: a transport timeout charges the request ledger and stays bounded
protocol_harness.name: h_api_timeout

second object of a shared region, so the same choice recurs later

same difference, second object of a shared region, so the same choice recurs later in a longer episode
one named candidate passes re-check; the same id is offered after the occupant moved onto it
identical state, candidate list presented in the opposite order: a model that only picks the first entry is detected here
the pending object was displaced across the table; the same pick is still legal but its geometry is not what the plan assumed
the same place with and without the occupant: no candidate clears the pre-check in the second context
held state unresolvable in one context (contact measured on two bodies): the honest move is to take a fresh measurement
the same descent measured once as a grasp miss and once as a completed pick, on the same object
two pending assignments swapped in the progress list; order must not be read as priority (SPEC 11.1: multiple legal orders)
everything done, versus one region member left outside
